description: Full registry of Epic (Dawncrest-eligible) craftable items in WoW Midnight, including Hero (318) and Myth (331) Dawncrest item levels and crafting qualities.

dawncrestReference.notes: In WoW Midnight, Dawncrest crafts span from Hero Dawncrest cap (ilvl 318, bonus 12493) to Myth Dawncrest cap (ilvl 331, bonus 12497). Crafting quality tiers (1-5) are an independent axis specifying stat efficiency and crafting difficulty.

mythDawncrest.description: Glorious Cluster of Myth Dawncrests infusion (ilvl 331)
